title.en: Explain critical point control and management by exception
Match causes of deviation with corrective actions

say.en: If the principal had to approve every late bus and every broken chalk, nothing else would get done. Smart control focuses on what really matters. In this lesson: Explain critical point control and management by exception.
Match causes of deviation with corrective actions.

body.en: Minor *deviations* are ignored and only significant ones are acted upon, using two ideas. Critical point control: focus on Key Result Areas (KRAs) critical to success, since a small change there, such as a 5% rise in labour cost, matters more than a 15% rise in postage. Management by exception: 'if you try to control everything, you may end up controlling nothing'; only significant deviations beyond a permissible limit are brought to the notice of top management.
body.kn: ಸಣ್ಣ ವಿಚಲನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು ಮುಖ್ಯವಾದವುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕ್ರಮ. ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಬಿಂದು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಕ್ಷೇತ್ರಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಗಮನ. ವಿನಾಯಿತಿಯಿಂದ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ: ಮಿತಿ ಮೀರಿದ ವಿಚಲನೆ ಮಾತ್ರ ಉನ್ನತ ಆಡಳಿತಕ್ಕೆ.

title.en: On the board: Which deviations matter?

narration.en: Not every deviation needs action. Two ideas help: critical point control and management by exception.

say.en: Not every deviation needs action. Two ideas help: critical point control and management by exception.
A 5 percent rise in labour cost of ten lakh is fifty thousand rupees.
A 15 percent rise in postage of twenty thousand is only three thousand. So labour is the critical point.
Find the cause, then take the matching corrective action.
Defective machine: repair. Obsolete machine: upgrade. Poor material: change specifications.
Untrained workers: train them. Low motivation: incentives. If nothing works, revise the standard.
Not every deviation needs action. Two ideas help: critical point control and management by exception.

narration.en: Each week the actual cost is compared with the standard. Deviations inside the permissible limit are ignored; only those outside it (red) go to top management.

body.en: *Corrective action* removes the cause of the deviation. Defective plant and machinery: repair. Obsolete machinery: replace or upgrade technology. Defective material: change quality specifications. Defective process: modify the process. Untrained workers: give training. Lack of motivation: introduce incentives. Defective physical conditions of work: improve them. If a deviation cannot be corrected, the standard itself may be revised.
body.kn: ತಿದ್ದುಪಡಿ ಕ್ರಮ ವಿಚಲನೆಯ ಕಾರಣ ನಿವಾರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: ದೋಷಯುಕ್ತ ಯಂತ್ರ ದುರಸ್ತಿ, ಹಳೆಯ ಯಂತ್ರ ಬದಲಾವಣೆ, ತರಬೇತಿ ಇಲ್ಲದವರಿಗೆ ತರಬೇತಿ, ಪ್ರೇರಣೆ ಕೊರತೆಗೆ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹಕ.

problem.en: In a factory, defective output rose because new workers did not know how to operate a machine, and the machine itself was 20 years old with outdated technology. Suggest corrective actions.

steps.en: Cause 1: untrained workers → arrange training programmes.
Cause 2: obsolete machinery → replace it or upgrade the technology.
Then measure again to check that defects return to the standard.

answer.en: Train the new workers and replace the obsolete machine.
